title: Junior Selection Committee Convenes
indian_angle: The meeting of the junior selection committee is crucial for identifying and nurturing India's future badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) held a meeting for its Junior Selection Committee on October 19, 2026, to discuss upcoming talent selections.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee ensures Indian players have a direct voice in the sport's governance and welfare.
summary: The Badminton Association of India officially announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2, 2026, aimed at enhancing player representation.

title: National Camp for World Junior Championships Begins in Guwahati
indian_angle: This national coaching camp in Guwahati is vital for preparing India's top junior players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 commenced at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati on September 24, 2026.

title: BAI Hosts Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course by BAI aims to elevate the coaching standards across India, benefiting aspiring badminton players nationwide.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Prepares for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: The Indian team coaching camp in Guwahati is crucial for the country's young talents ahead of the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 was held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, starting August 7, 2026.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The implementation of the 3x15 scoring system in domestic junior tournaments will significantly impact how young Indian players compete and develop.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, effective June 30, 2026.
